items.question: What was the UAE federal budget allocated to the Ministry of Human Resources and Emiratisation (MoHRE) for developing human resources in 2025, in AED?
items.fact: MoHRE 2025 human resources development budget was 642,897,000 AED

items.question: Which UAE federal authority regulates employment in federal government entities?
items.gold: The Federal Authority for Government Human Resources (FAHR) regulates employment in federal government entities.
items.fact: FAHR regulates employment in federal government entities
